           ROSA DAMASCENA

         Damask Rose


Useful in the beginning of hay-fever, with involvement of Eustachian
        tube.



Ear.--  Hardness of hearing; tinnitus.   Eustachian
        catarrh   (  Hydr; Merc dulc  ).



Relationship.--  Compare: in hay-fever:   Phleum
        pratense  --Timothy grass--(Hay-fever with asthma; watery coryza, itching of nose
        and eyes; frequent sneezing, dyspnœa. Use 6-30 potency. Rabe).   Succin
        acid; Sabad; Euph; Psor; Kali hyd; Naphth  .



Dose.--  Lower potencies.
